textTemplates.description: Used as an error message body
textTemplates.name: Error_Message_Body
textTemplates.text:
Hello,


A user from {!Get_Contact.Account.Name} has encountered an error while trying to submit a Case. A TechOps case has just been created to troubleshoot this flow, but in the meantime, please reach out to this user to gather any necessary information regarding their request:


Flow that Failed: WebCase (scaleMatters)

Element that Failed: {!varElementError}

Case Submitter: {!Get_Contact.FirstName} {!Get_Contact.LastName} -- {!Get_Contact.Email}

Company: {!Get_Contact.Account.Name}

Time: {!$Flow.CurrentDateTime}

Case URL: https://scalematters.lightning.force.com/{!Get_Created_Case_Info.Id}


Flow Error Message: {!$Flow.FaultMessage}
